foundation.framingA.title: Eto nasha pervaya vstrecha.
foundation.framingA.body:
Sem tikhikh voprosov — no vy mozhete ostanovitsya posle trekh i uvidet svoye pervoye chteniye.

 Net pravilnykh otvetov. Chestnost luchshe krasoty.

 Eto ne test. Eto pervaya fotografiya togo, gde vy nakhodites pryamo seychas, chtoby ya mog vstretitsya s vami tam.
foundation.framingB.title: Eto vash fundament.
foundation.framingB.body:
To, chto vy tolko chto dali mne, stanovitsya vashim nachalnym diapazonom.

 V techeniye sleduyushchikh dney ya budu prodolzhat perekalibrovku — eto ne test, eto pervaya fotografiya.

foundation.q8.title: U tseba hakae ho sheba menahano a hau?
foundation.paths.observationDesc: Waarnemend wat is, zonder grijpen of duwen. Elke weg die we samen bewandelen begint vanuit deze zetel.
foundation.paths.startingPoint: Nene be tã ma ko — tã ba mɛ ko. Ma tã ma kpo ma bã ko me ko.
